description.value: Monzo Burger is a smashburger restaurant located in Vancouver House on Granville Street, inspired by the 1980s Milanese youth movement known as the 'Paninari.' The menu centres on house-ground Canadian beef smash patties, hand-made chicken cutlets, beef-tallow fries, and soft serve gelato, alongside a custom Italian-style pilsner brewed in collaboration with Ravens Brewing. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a full sit-down meal with online ordering and a vegetarian burger option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open ('Open 11am - Midnight daily' on the front page) and corroborates the OSM address (1401 Granville Street, Vancouver, BC V6Z 1R8). The menu explicitly labels 'BIG LEGUME (V)' as a vegetarian option, and the presence of an 'ORDER ONLINE' link confirms takeout availability. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears anywhere on the site; the subpage's 'Opening Summer 2023' language appears to be a legacy pre-launch page, superseded by the live main page content.
